summary.text: Izzy Smith-Wade-El (Ismail Smith-Wade-El) is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 49 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Lancaster native, he previously served five years on Lancaster City Council, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Smith-Wade-El was born in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, earned a high school diploma from West Nottingham Academy, and received a bachelor's degree from Carnegie Mellon University in 2014.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he first ran for City Council in 2017.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Committee on Committees and the Education, Urban Affairs & Housing, Human Services and Local Government committees.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had written legislation on housing access and affordability, protections for queer and trans youth, and support for immigrants and refugees.
In that survey he listed increased tenant protections, fair funding for Lancaster schools and raising the minimum wage among his campaign messages.
Republican Vanessa Acosta is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
